payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-04 current automation inventory audited; registry/enforcement design fixed before implementation.
payload.next_action: Implement canonical automation-registry.json plus fail-closed mutation-inbox authorization and tests on the claimed branch.
decisions: Every mutation request will require a non-empty actor_id.
actor_id values beginning automation: must match one canonical registry entry exactly.
Registered automation mutations require enabled=true, control_plane_mutation capability, an allowed operation, and an allowed target-lane policy.
Reviewer automation may review worker lanes but may not claim, implement, or mutate the main-reviewer lane.
Disabled canonical writers remain registered as disabled so stale execution is explicitly rejected.
Read-only enabled automations are tracked but receive no control-plane mutation operations.
